description: F-ZARB; flew with the 62e, 64e and 63e escadres de transport, was converted to RNR standard at the AIA in 1969-70, then served with Groupe Ecole 316 as 316-FO until 1987, retiring with 10,447 flying hours. Displayed statically at BA 115 Orange-Caritat before being moved to the 1er Regiment de Chasseurs Parachutistes at Pamiers on 27 January 2006, where it wears the code 64-IB with the radar nose removed.
